recoveryDispositions.reason: SH excludes only fixed power savings in the graph-order exponent and prefactors bounded by an exponential of a fixed polynomial in k. The historical exclusion allows a rate such as k/log₂(k+2) and every computable prefactor.
The exclusion bounds the graph-order exponent by an arbitrary fixed constant. The historical exclusion allows that exponent to grow as any sublinear function of k.

recoveryAssessments.comparison: The historical and square-hypothesis bounds exclude the same unrestricted deterministic time family, with total graph order as the exponent base and every computable prefactor.
